title: 3D in vivo dose verification in prostate proton therapy with deep learning-based proton-acoustic imaging
summary: Deep-learning proton-acoustic imaging reconstructs in-vivo prostate proton-dose distributions and supports a specific 3D dose-verification result.
ai_technology: Methods model proton-acoustic generation/reconstruction; Results compare reconstructed 3D pressure/dose maps with the reference and report artifact correction in treatment cases.
organization: Duke University; Duke University Medical Center

evidence.tested: Deep-learning proton-acoustic imaging reconstructs in-vivo prostate proton-dose distributions and supports a specific 3D dose-verification result.
evidence.unknown: Proof-of-concept measurement and image reconstruction are not evidence of improved patient outcomes. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Methods model proton-acoustic generation/reconstruction; Results compare reconstructed 3D pressure/dose maps with the reference and report artifact correction in treatment cases.
